# HeCBench subset run by the test_hecbench CI job (amdgcnspirv-be backend).
# One benchmark directory name (under HeCBench/src) per line, sorted; '#'
# comments and blank lines are ignored. bench.sh runs them in file order.
#
# Entries must be hermetic: no external data (DVC / tarballs /
# download_datasets.sh) and no libraries missing from the CI staging (hipblas,
# hipfft, hipsparse, hipsolver, -lomp, gsl, boost, numpy, ...), and must build
# and self-verify on the amdgcnspirv-be path in the pinned CI container.
# Per-benchmark run-arg overrides live in ci_run_args.txt. After editing, re-run
# update_deps.sh to regenerate ci_benchmarks.deps.txt.
